description: Now: each non-ASCII character ends the run; Utf8.next makes a {:ok, cp, rest} tuple and a new binary, and acc <> run <> cp copies the accumulated string twice. 333 x 世: 334 structs, 624 shared bins, 332,280 shared bytes. 333 x \u4e16: 332,280 shared bytes. Change: a run continues through <<c::utf8, r::binary>> when c >= 128; \u appends <<cp::utf8>> directly; invalid UTF-8 reaches the failing clause with the byte in hand. Predicted: 世 struct 334 -> 0, shared bytes 332,280 -> 0; \u shared bytes -> <= 2,100. Deletes Utf8.next/1, Utf8.from_codepoint/1, fz_bitstring_utf8_prefix (+ runtime tests), fixtures2/behavior/utf8_next.fz and utf8_from_codepoint.fz, unicode_scalar and its unreachable :invalid_codepoint arm, run_join's second slice; updates .agent/docs/semantic-authorities.md:369-376; fixes fixture 01164's false header and lowers its pins. Needs S3; measured on S1, S2 and fz-sc8.208. Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-json-garbage.html (approved 2026-11-14). Worktree ../fz-json, base bd3edae98.
